segments.title: Cold Open: Pepito Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour broadcast sign-on from Case's house, noting Munch remains a skeleton.

segments.title: Casual Friday Housekeeping
segments.notes: Case discusses casual Friday attire, Chicago Sketch Fest appearance on October 4, upcoming travel, and channel point reward discounts.

segments.title: Hype Train Derailment: Grandma Piss Freestyle
segments.notes: Hype Train commandeers the broadcast for a freestyle rap about generational piss knowledge, thanks subscribers, and claims fusion with Kendall.

segments.title: World News: Iran Deal & Trump-Xi Meeting
segments.notes: Case and Pepito cover Iran's proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, Trump-Xi state visit optics, and Netanyahu's UN appearance.

segments.title: Chat News: Viewer Submissions
segments.notes: Case reads viewer-submitted stories: Texas nursery fight club lawsuit, bestiality felony charge, shortest firefighter record, Wyoming profanity trial, and prehistoric penis evolution article.

segments.title: Munch & Crum: Lindsey Clancy Debate
segments.notes: Skeleton Munch and Crum debate the Lindsey Clancy case with Kendelle intervening; Munch claims Lord of the Dead title and summonable penis.

segments.title: Trailer Review: Madden, Fresh Meat, StarCraft
segments.notes: New correspondent John ('President mob John') and Chris join Case for trailer reactions; John challenges Brandon to a fight.

segments.title: Wrap-Up & Raid
segments.notes: Case departs for Filipino cartoon movie, raids Doctor Diggity, and teases Monday ring-sizing secret stream with Kendall.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors abbreviated Friday broadcast, announces Chicago Sketch Fest appearance, manages Hype Train derailment and skeleton Munch debate.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers cold-open sign-on from Case's house, interrupts Hype Train segment, identifies Kendall in the room.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: musical interruption. Derails broadcast with grandma-themed freestyle about piss, thanks subscribers, claims to be part-train fused with Kendall.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Returns as immortal talking skeleton after Crum Dick Punch incident, claims Lord of the Dead title and summonable penis.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Debates Lindsey Clancy case against skeleton Munch, maintains gambling addict persona and anatomical resilience claims.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Appears in-studio during Hype Train segment, confirms engagement, dances on camera, sides with Lindsey Clancy.

characters.name: Chris
characters.notes: guest correspondent. Co-hosts trailer segment with John and Case, present during StarCraft and Madden trailer reactions.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell hosts a truncated Casual Friday broadcast from the BIN newsroom, interrupted by Hype Train's piss-obsessed freestyle and a Munch & Crum debate where skeleton Munch asserts his new immortal Lord of the Dead status. The hour closes with a trailer review segment featuring new correspondent John before Case departs for a Filipino animated film and raids Doctor Diggity.
